rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a talk-style seminar, including many academic and business events.

example.english: I signed up for a photography seminar to learn how to take better pictures.
example.traditional: 我報咗個手機攝影講座，學下點樣影靚相。
example.jyutping: ngo5 bou3 zo2 go3 sau2 gei1 sip3 jing2 gong2 zo6 hok6 haa5 dim2 joeng2 jing2 leng3 soeng2

rows.note: Use this when the seminar emphasizes discussion and the exchange of research or professional information.

example.english: The research teams exchanged their latest findings at the seminar.
example.traditional: 研究團隊喺研討會上交流最新結果。
example.jyutping: jin4 gau3 tyun4 deoi2 hai2 jin4 tou2 wui2 soeng6 gaau1 lau4 zeoi3 san1 git3 gwo2

rows.note: Use this specifically for a regular advanced academic discussion class under a teacher or professor.

example.english: The professor leads our seminar every week, discussing the papers one by one.
example.traditional: 教授每個星期帶我哋上研討班，逐篇討論論文。
example.jyutping: gaau3 sau6 mui5 go3 sing1 kei4 daai2 ngo5 dei6 soeng5 jin4 tou2 baan1 zuk6 pin1 tou2 leon6 leon6 man4
